title: What It Really Costs to Own a Bugatti Chiron
description:
A Bugatti Chiron started at two point four million euros. That is the number everyone knows. But the price on the order form was only the entry ticket. One owner's normal annual service was about eleven thousand five hundred dollars. A single taillight was quoted at more than ten thousand dollars. And a replacement engine was listed at about eight hundred fifty-six thousand dollars. So what does a Chiron really cost to own? Today we follow the money from the first deposit to the day you sell. The buying, the options, the insurance, the service, the parts that wear, the fuel, and the surprise at the end, because for many owners, the Chiron did something almost no car does. It made money.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
